page.notes: Right-hand margin: only the first letters of notes are visible, cut off by the edge of the scan. These are illegible and are not transcribed. Line ends at the right edge are cropped, so some words are incomplete (for example "calumnian", "juratam", "compellans", "promferant"). They are copied as far as they show; the rest is not reconstructed. "pi[?]" at the end of the first verse line: the word is cut off by the scan edge. Probably "per", but not legible. "Regili": the word breaks across lines ("Regi" / "li"), and no hyphen is visible; written whole. Long s has been rendered as s throughout (for example "suæ", "sibi", "esse", "insignis"), following the rule. Running head: the printed "Juramenti" is written as "Iuramenti", following the rule on i/j.
